title: Natural Resources Conservation Authority Act, 1991 (Act 9 of 1991)
citation: Natural Resources Conservation Authority Act, Act 9 of 1991, as amended up to Act 36 of 2017 in the Laws of Jamaica edition
evidence: Revised Laws text on the Legal Information Portal (record 75192, OCR): header "Acts 9 of 1991, 36 of 2017 [5th July 1991.]" and s. 2: "\"appointed day\" means the 5th day of July, 1991". Opened 2026-11-05 via https://lipj.gov.jm/cms/api/records/75192?populate[ocr][fields][0]=text.

title: Consumer Protection Act, 2005 (Act 9 of 2005)
citation: Consumer Protection Act, Act 9 of 2005, as amended by Acts 15 of 2006 and 13 of 2012 in the Laws of Jamaica edition (L.N. 128/2016); Part V, ss. 28 to 30
evidence: Revised Laws text on the Legal Information Portal (record 75623, OCR): header "Acts 9 of 2005, 15 of 2006, 13 of 2012 [1st June 2005.]". Opened 2026-11-05 via https://lipj.gov.jm/cms/api/records/75623?populate[ocr][fields][0]=text.
notes: Part V (Misleading and Deceptive Conduct) lists s. 28 misleading or deceptive conduct, s. 29 misleading the public as to the nature of goods or services, and s. 30 false or misleading representation; s. 30(1) reads: "No person shall, in the course of trade or business, in connection with the supply or possible supply of goods or services or with the promotion by any means of the supply or use of goods or services (a) falsely represent that the goods or services are of a particular kind, standard, quality, grade, quantity ..." and (b) bars a false or misleading representation about price, need, or a condition, warranty, guarantee, right or remedy. Read from the arrangement of sections and the OCR of s. 30 (the OCR of this edition is imperfect); no environmental-claims provision was found, so this is an umbrella for green claims only. Regulator: Consumer Affairs Commission. The portal also lists the 2012 and 2023 amending Acts.
